neo4j_schema_vintages_seen.note: chat_nextseek's context/ holds THREE schema files with very different Sample-property counts. The bundled copy is the 85-property LIVE file, chosen because chat_nextseek's own config.py _ensure_neo4j_schema()/_fetch_neo4j_schema loads exactly neo4j_schema.json and overwrites it from the production graph on each fetch -- so that file is what the running system actually reads. Do NOT 'upgrade' to the 200-property dump.
neo4j_schema_vintages_seen.neo4j_schema.json: 23 Sample properties in the DEV snapshot fetched 2026-03-26; 85 in the LIVE production copy fetched 2026-05-11 (bundled here).
neo4j_schema_vintages_seen.neo4j_schema_dev.json: 23 Sample properties, fetched 2026-03-26 -- the stale DEV snapshot; byte-identical to what this plugin shipped through 2026-05-27. This was the bug.
neo4j_schema_vintages_seen.neo4j_schema_prod.json: 200 Sample properties, fetched 2026-03-26 -- an OLDER, uncurated/flattened raw dump that the live system does NOT load. Its overlap with the live 85-prop file is only 27 properties: a different shape, not a newer version. NOT bundled.
